parsed.post: Discarding TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10': EVAL_SHARD=10, so training on the eval shard likely inflated val_bpb. Reverting to clean shards 0-9. Next clean single-knob: DEPTH=4->5, keeping halved batch 262144, LR 0.08, no warmup. Avoid using eval shard for training.
parsed.description: Clean experiment: increase depth from 4 to 5 while keeping TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9', batch size 262144, matrix LR 0.08, and no warmup.
parsed.report_to_operator: Multiple agents report large gains from TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', but EVAL_SHARD=10; those gains are likely train-on-eval leakage. Please confirm intended train/eval separation.
